# secobserve_service (Data Source)

Looks up a service by product and exact name. Service names are unique per product, so both are required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secobserve_service" "api" {
  product = data.secobserve_product.checkout.id
  name    = "api"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the service.
- `product` (Number) Id of the product the service belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the service.
- `name_with_product` (String) Service name qualified with its product.
